card.name: Scattered web-page text, no theme
card.fires_on: No shared word or setting; it fires on assorted spots such as a digit in a year, a name part, a comma, or a common word in web copy.
card.writes: It lowers praise adjectives such as excellent, fantastic and wonderful, but the link to the contexts is weak.
card.plain: It shows no clear pattern; the marked words are a mix of unrelated bits of ordinary web text.
